channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Whataburger: 76-Cent Taquito with Cheese - Today Only
item.guid: Whataburger-76-Cent Taquito with Cheese - Today Only-2026-08-05
item.description: On Aug. 5 only, get a Taquito with Cheese for just 76 cents via the Whataburger App (6-11 AM, participating locations) as part of the chain's 76th anniversary celebration. (August 5, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu
item.description: Choose from 3pc Signature Chicken, 3pc Tenders, a Chicken Sandwich, or 8pc Butterfly Shrimp for just $5 - order in store, online, or in the app. (Through August 30, 2026)

item.title: Burger King: Free Fries Any Size with Any Purchase
item.guid: Burger King-Free Fries Any Size with Any Purchase-2026-08-05
item.description: Get free French fries in any size with any purchase via the BK app - stack on top of the $5 Your Way Meal for maximum value. (Ongoing)

item.title: McDonald's: 40% Off Double Cheeseburger or 6pc Chicken Nuggets
item.guid: McDonald's-40% Off Double Cheeseburger or 6pc Chick-2026-08-05
item.description: Open the McDonald's app for a limited-time 40% off offer on a Double Cheeseburger or 6-piece Chicken McNuggets - no minimum purchase required. (Limited time)

item.title: Burger King: $5 Your Way Meal
item.description: Build a meal with a sandwich, nuggets, fries, and a drink for $5 every day via the BK app - one of the best ongoing fast-food values. (Ongoing)

item.title: KFC: 5 Chicken Tenders for $5
item.description: Grab five crispy KFC Chicken Tenders for just $5 when you order digitally through the KFC app or website. (Limited time)

item.title: Taco Bell: $5.99 Luxe Cravings Box
item.description: The Luxe Cravings Box includes a Chalupa Supreme, Beefy 5-Layer Burrito, Double Stacked Taco, chips and nacho cheese sauce, and a medium drink - order in app or in store. (Ongoing)

item.title: Arby's: Meat and 3 Box for $7.99
item.description: The Meat and 3 Box includes a Crispy Chicken or Ham and Swiss Sandwich, small fry, 2-piece Mozzarella Sticks, Peach Cobbler Roll, and a small drink for $7.99. (Limited time)

item.title: Sonic: $1.99 Everyday Value Menu
item.description: Sonic's $1.99 Menu is available every day and includes items like the Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger and Chicken Wrap - order in-app or at the drive-in. (Ongoing)

item.title: Krispy Kreme: Buy Any Dozen, Get a Dozen Glazed for $1
item.guid: Krispy Kreme-Buy Any Dozen, Get a Dozen Glazed for $1-2026-08-05
item.description: Buy any dozen doughnuts and add a dozen Original Glazed for just $1 at Krispy Kreme - one of the brand's best recurring value offers. (Limited time)

item.title: Dairy Queen: BOGO Blizzard for 99 Cents Through August 30
item.guid: Dairy Queen-BOGO Blizzard for 99 Cents Through Augus-2026-08-05
item.description: Buy one Blizzard Treat and get a second Blizzard for 99 cents via the DQ app or online order - valid daily through August 30, 2026. (Through August 30, 2026)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
